zh: 土耳其軍用S-70墜毀，4名軍職人員死亡
en: Four Turkish service members killed in military S-70 helicopter crash.

zh: 五起獨立航空事件：客艙煙霧、擋風玻璃破裂等
en: Five independent aviation incidents include cabin smoke and other events.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：澤倫斯基稱 Starshield 速限再現，影響攔截俄羅斯噴射動力無人機；波蘭正敲定向烏克蘭移交MiG-29戰機，換取接觸烏方無人機及反無人機技術
en: Aviation briefs: Zelenskyy says renewed Starshield speed cap hinders interception of Russian jet-powered drones; Poland is finalizing MiG-29 transfer plans to Ukraine for drone and counter-drone technology access

zh: Sikorsky S-70直升機墜毀，4名土耳其軍人死亡
en: Four Turkish service members killed in military Sikorsky S-70 helicopter crash.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：捷克研議向烏克蘭供應最多16架L-39 Skyfox；阿聯酋航空將取得六架空中巴士A380-800
en: Aviation briefs: Czechia weighs supplying Ukraine with up to 16 L-39 Skyfox jets; Emirates to Take Ownership of Six Airbus A380-800s

zh: 航空短訊彙整：國泰航空行使購機權增購11架空中巴士A330-900，該型機確定訂單增至41架；Archer Aviation與Formula 1簽署合作 探索賽事空中計程車服務
en: Aviation briefs: Cathay Pacific Exercises Rights for 11 More Airbus A330-900s, Firm Total Reaches 41; Archer Aviation and Formula 1 sign partnership to explore air taxi flights at races

zh: 屏東與長榮航空邀德國業者踩線
en: Pingtung and EVA Air host German tourism operators on a scouting visit.

zh: 波音10月交付49架，737 MAX交付32架
en: Boeing delivered 49 aircraft in October; 737 MAX deliveries fell to 32.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：美聯航華盛頓杜勒斯機場E航廈啟用，首期設14個登機門；澳航A321XLR將首度飛國際線，布里斯本—馬尼拉2027年2月上線
en: Aviation briefs: United Airlines opens new Concourse E at Washington Dulles Airport; Qantas to take Airbus A321XLR international from Brisbane to Manila

zh: NTSB尋獲Learjet 60駕駛艙語音記錄器
en: NTSB recovers Learjet 60 cockpit voice recorder.
